hook.name: PrismReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for a PRISM token pool that collects a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy fees accumulate as native ETH in a reflection pot, and sell fees are sent directly to the token contract as reflections. Every 20 swaps, accumulated ETH is used to buy back PRISM tokens and distribute them as reflections via the token contract.
